title: Splitting p1 (1xT75) to p2 (2xT150)
author: Andrea Argouarch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gnhtve

steps.title: Prepare Hood and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the sterile environment and gather all necessary materials.

substeps.instruction: Turn off UV lights and clean the hood with 70% ethanol.

Clean the following items with 70% ethanol and bring them into the hood: DPBS (-/- calcium, -/- magnesium, Thermo Fisher #14190250), Sterile Filtered Media (DMEM high glucose pyruvate Thermo Fisher #11995073, Penicillin-Streptomycin Gibco #15140122, Fetal Bovine Serum VWR #97068-091), and 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA phenol red (Thermo Fisher #25300062).

steps.title: Prepare Target Flasks
steps.instruction: Label and prime the new flasks.

substeps.instruction: Label 2xT150 flasks with ID, date, and 'p2'.
Add 28 mL of media to each flask.

steps.title: Rinse Cells
steps.instruction: Rinse the T75 flask containing cells at 90-100% confluency.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of DPBS to the flask and gently swirl.

steps.title: Detach Cells
steps.instruction: Use trypsin to detach cells from the flask surface.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 0.05% trypsin to the flask.
Place in incubator at 37 °C for 2-3 minutes until cells start to detach.
Gently tap the side of the flask to assist detachment if necessary.

steps.title: Inactivate Trypsin
steps.instruction: Stop the trypsinization process using media.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of fibroblast media to the flask to inactivate the trypsin.

steps.title: Harvest and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Collect and concentrate the cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Collect the cell suspension into a 15 mL conical tube.
Aspirate the supernatant, ensuring the cell pellet remains undisturbed.
Add 4 mL of fibroblast media to the pellet.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Distribute the cells into the prepared T150 flasks.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of the cell suspension to each of the 2xT150 flasks.

steps.title: Incubate and Maintain
steps.instruction: Incubate the flasks and maintain the culture.

substeps.instruction: Place flasks in the incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Observe and feed the cells the next day, then feed every 2-3 days until 90-100% confluent.
Clean and sterilize the hood with 70% ethanol and turn on the UV light.
